human_strengths: The idea of zero-shot video generation with pretrained image generation is worthwhile to explore, which can maximally maintain and leverage the generation ability of the 2D model.
human_review_text: This paper proposes an approach for generating smooth videos from trained text-to-image model without finetuning. The approach contains two parts, one is about constructing noise across frames that stays relatively consistent; the other is about changing the self-attention layers of 2D U-Net to cross-frame attention accumulated over time. Results show that the method can generate reasonable moving videos.
